usage.note: {runs} runs this month, {seconds} s of warehouse time. Credits assume an XS warehouse (1 credit per running hour).
usage.started: Started. New cards appear in about a minute.

wf1.name: Weekly run
wf1.what: Every metric back to back, then per role: detect signals, build the prompt, write cards, validate and store. Ends with WF6.

wf1a.name: Role pipeline
wf1a.when: Called by WF1 and WF2, once per role
wf1a.what: detect -> prompt -> LLM -> ingest. A failed role is marked and the run moves on.

wf2.name: Daily check
wf2.what: daily_check metrics and daily-cadence roles; a threshold breach runs that role's pipeline.

wf3.name: Remeasure
wf3.what: Midpoint and end measurements of initiatives, written as outcomes; then WF6.

wf4.name: Weekly digest
wf4.what: Emails each person their new cards and value captured.

wf5.name: Feedback compiler
wf5.what: Proposes downweight and forbid rules from repeated feedback, for review.

wf6.name: Roll-up
wf6.when: End of WF1, WF2 and WF3
wf6.what: Refreshes open cards and value captured per role and team.

wf7.name: Health
wf7.what: Stale runs, credit use against the cap, LLM log retention, warehouse login.

wf0.name: Error handler
wf0.what: Marks that execution's runs as failed.

workflows.note: n8n schedules and sequences these calls; every decision is made by the API. Editor: http://localhost:5678 (local only).

glossary.counted: Read straight from your data, nothing added.
glossary.estimated: Our calculation from your data. Shown to rank problems, not as an accounting figure.
glossary.atStake: The money tied up or at risk compared with what is usual for you, over the next quarter (estimated).
glossary.card: A short note for one person: what happened, why it matters, what to do.
glossary.alert: The level at which a measure becomes a card for someone.
glossary.usual: What is normal for you: the average of recent weeks before the latest ones.
glossary.notSellable: Stock you hold but cannot sell yet: damaged, in quarantine, or returned.
glossary.realCounts: Stock counts your system recorded, without back-filled or repeated rows.
glossary.roleType: The kind of job a role does, which decides the playbook its cards follow.
glossary.preset: How much you hear: Fewer, Balanced or More. Our team turns it into settings.
glossary.trial: A full run on your data before anyone receives cards, so you can check them.
glossary.measure: A number we compute every week, such as stock held in non-sellable locations.
